faq_examples.question: Kaunsa plywood use hota hai?
faq_examples.answer: Project aur budget ke according CenturyPly, Greenply, ya Action Tesa boards use kiye jaate hain.

faq_examples.question: Kitchen hardware kaunsa use hota hai?
faq_examples.answer: Hettich, Hafele, aur Inox jaise premium brands use kiye jaate hain.

faq_examples.question: Approx modular kitchen cost?
faq_examples.answer: Kitchen size, hardware, laminate, aur accessories ke according pricing vary karti hai. Better estimate ke liye site visit recommended hai.
